content: Sake eboku, Pyere eghangu
Va temu eni, kaghe Yirode akeghangise mwa dikabu di batu ba dibundu mu bakwane.
Na didjenge akebokise Sake, mwane ngudji San.
Anolabe yi baSwife bamadironde, akeghangise Pyere va temu mumengu wu bapembi abagha dufunusu.
Yirode akemughaange nomusunze o tsughu. Akesindighe binombu bine bi baghore mu mukelisaange. Kadi yinombu yimabe ghore djine. Amabe na ditase dyumufundise, va ghari batu yike mumengu Pake wivyoyi.
Pyere abilange o tsughu, bise dibundu bamasambile Nzambi na yikanene mu djandi.
Yanze yipalisi Pyere o tsughu
Yirode amabe na ditase dyumubeghe va wusu banzonzi. Tumbe mune mukolu, Pyere amabe atungu pange bedji, na amabe yilu va ghari ghore bedji. Baghore bamosi, bamamoghaange va wusu mune ndaghu tsughu.

Sundile, yanze yi Fumu yikekote mba tsughu djotsu djikekademe na yidjalale. Yanze yikekungise Pyere nomudimbe mbate o maghetu, mba akemutsingule yi: «Lenge noreleme!» Na bapange baketudughe mu makake mandi.
Yanze yike muvaghe yiri: «Tunge beleti aghu na dware bapondu baghu.» Akedivaghe. Yanze yikemwémuvaghe yi: «Dware yikutu yaghu na nduki.»
Pyere akeduke yanze na akepale o tsughu. Asamadjabaange yiri adi yanze amavaghaange dingenze, amatasaange yiri yiryaryamu.

Bakevyoghe yinombu yi baghore ayiteghe, bakevyoghe ayi mubedji, baketole va yabutsu yi madilu ayi mune ndaghu awumusitu. Yabutsu yeni yikedibughe pinze va wusu owu na bakepale. Banosupughe mu nzile, yanze yikekakene nandi.

Kaboghu Pyere akewulu adimavyoghaange, na akekévosile yi: «Mba nyimadjabe yi dingenze: Fumu atsitinde yanze yandi, na djandi, atsinkaghule va makake ma Yirode, na ame bivunde bi baSwife mbé baronde undase.»
Ave amadiwululu nane, akewende o ndaghu Mari, ngudji San adjinengulu Mareke. Aghune, batu bapwele bamabe baghukeme na bamasambililaange.
Ave Pyere amakokemunine mu yabutsu yi mune ndaghu, musatsi mughetu, awinengulu Rode, akebambene mughulu.
Akedjabe dyufi di Pyere, tumbe na kini asamadibule, aketsingule abamabe o ghari yi Pyere adji va dulombili.
Bakemuvaghe yi: «Wune bulaghu!» Tumbe amatsiyisaange yi ngenze. Kaboghu bakevaghe yi: «Awune tangudji yanze yandi.»
Yotsu yina, Pyere ukokemune mbé akikokemune. Bakemudibulile yabutsu, na bakesutu ave bamamulabile.
Akesambe dikake mubavotse, akebatsingule nane Fumu amamupalisile o tsughu, mba akebasindighe yiri: «Wendanu yétsingulanu Sake na baane ba tadji basusu.» Anomane, akepale nowende yari yisusu.
Wisi anotebughe, vakebe nkumfu neni va ghari baghore. Djowu bamakewivulaange: «Pyere akewuke?»
Yirode akeveghe dirume dyumurombe, tumbe basamamulabe. Akewave baghore, na akeveghe musughe wu baboke. Va djulu vane, akeghusughe o yinange yi Sudé novindeme o musyengi Sesaré mu yévume mwa temu.
Dufu du kaghe Yirode Agheripa

Yirode amabe na kabu neni na bise Tire na bise Sidone. Djowu bakewulusunu va mosi mu sumbe yivunde, ayimakelisaange bime byotsu bi kaghe, dine dyandi Balesetose. Bamavayile nane, mumbari bamarondaange uvonde duvotsu na kaghe Yirode, dibilaange yiri bighudji byowu byotsu, bimarughesenaange o bulongu bwandi.
Mu yilumbu ayi bamasikighe, Yirode akedware yidjunge yi bukaghe, aketsane va yitsighe yandi yi bufumu, mba akebavosilaange.
Yike yinombu yimaghamughe yiri: «Djandi evosi nane nyambi, tsiri nane mutu!»
Tumbe vane-vane, yanze yi Fumu yikemudimbe, mumba amabonge bundumbe bu Nzambi: akelighu na misobe, na akefu.
Musamu wu Nzambi wumanyavaange laviri.
Barenabase na Sole yikebemani yisalu yowu o musyengi Serusaleme, bakeyeneghabughe, na bamabeghe nowu San awu amanengulungu Mareke.
